svg.title: Regressions are larger for the selected minority accents

cc:Work.dc:title: Regressions are larger for the selected minority accents
cc:Work.dc:description: Table II mean degradation in percentage points. Filled diamonds denote significance in the paper’s one-sided bootstrap test; hollow diamonds denote the two nonsignificant comparisons (SAA and OpenSLR-83). All eight point estimates are higher for the selected minority accent. MD averages only positive changes over all older/newer model pairs, not only adjacent releases.
